Definition: from G5221; an encounter or concurrence (with G1519 for infinitive, in order to fall in with):--meeting.
BiblicalUsage: hypántēsis is the word for meeting. In Matthew 8:34, the text says "the whole city came out to meet Jesus." In Matthew 25:1, the text says "and went forth to meet the bridegroom."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, hypántēsis is a reminder that fellowship is sharing life together under Christ, not just sharing a room. That shapes how I read the passages where it appears: not as filler, but as God's own wording for what He is doing.
RelatedEvents: Triumphal Entry; Jesus Heals the Gerasene Demoniac; The Wise and Foolish Virgins
